traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills very distant, few and narrow, often reduced to irregular vein-like folds, sometimes forked or interconnected; white to pale cream
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills very distant, few and narrow, often reduced to irregular vein-like folds, sometimes forked or interconnected; white to pale cream

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Hemispherical to convex when young, later flattened or shallowly depressed; extremely thin, dry, smooth to finely pruinose, becoming radially wrinkled; white to ivory; margin slightly wavy
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Hemispherical to convex when young, later flattened or shallowly depressed; extremely thin, dry, smooth to finely pruinose, becoming radially wrinkled; white to ivory; margin slightly wavy

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnate to shortly decurrent, sometimes forming a partial collar
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to shortly decurrent, sometimes forming a partial collar

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Extremely slender, thread-like, tough and wiry; whitish near apex, dark reddish-brown toward base; finely pruinose to minutely hairy; ring absent
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Extremely slender, thread-like, tough and wiry; whitish near apex, dark reddish-brown toward base; finely pruinose to minutely hairy; ring absent

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore print white
traits.raw: ⚪ Spore print white

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Saprobic on decaying hardwood leaves, petioles; deciduous and mixed forests, usually scattered to gregariously; summer to late autumn
traits.raw: 🍁🍂 Saprobic on decaying hardwood leaves, petioles; deciduous and mixed forests, usually scattered to gregariously; summer to late autumn

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Inedible; extremely small and insubstantial
traits.raw: 😒 Inedible; extremely small and insubstantial

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body tiny; stipe ~0.5–3 cm long and ~0.1–0.5 mm thick
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body tiny; stipe ~0.5–3 cm long and ~0.1–0.5 mm thick

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Cap ∅ ~1–10 mm
traits.raw: 📐 Cap ∅ ~1–10 mm

traits.label: Flesh
traits.text: Whitish to pale cream, membranous, extremely thin and pliant; unchanging when cut; drying out and reviving with moisture
traits.raw: 🔪 Whitish to pale cream, membranous, extremely thin and pliant; unchanging when cut; drying out and reviving with moisture

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores elongated-ellipsoid to lacrymoid, smooth, hyaline, inamyloid, ~8.5–12.5 × 3–5 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; cheilocystidia fusiform to lageniform, often with elongated necks; pleurocystidia scattered; pileipellis hymeniform; clamp connections present
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores elongated-ellipsoid to lacrymoid, smooth, hyaline, inamyloid, ~8.5–12.5 × 3–5 µm; basidia predominantly 4-spored; cheilocystidia fusiform to lageniform, often with elongated necks; pleurocystidia scattered; pileipellis hymeniform; clamp connections present

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Tiny white leaf parachute with reduced vein-like gills and a hair-thin brown stipe
